_: How a people or a blood came to be when it did not arise: the key a people's origin and a blood's making carry, and the parties. The view renders the text: {C} the people that made it (by), {S} the people it was made from, {L} the remain, {T} the remain's star, {E} the remain's elder, {P} the plague.
origins: one row per key: text; desc; parties (which ids the text names).
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.
